title: 第171章 “滚。”
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

方喻之微微拧眉，起初他只以为是祝砚铮因为宋瓷不是宋家人，为了让孟晚开心想要惩罚宋瓷。

想到这里，方喻之脸色更沉，对着电话那头低吼道：“祝砚铮，你放开她！”

“别伤害她，她是无辜的！”

“我会带她走的！我不会再让她出现在你面前！”

可不知是不是他的错觉，好像他每说一句，电话那头少女的哭声就更重一分。

到最后，细微又绵软的哭声像是抑制不住一般，变成了断断续续地啜泣。

方喻之瞪圆了眼睛，似乎总算意识到了些不对劲。

这是……

手指将手机捏得很紧，方喻之听着手机里传来的声音，喉结滚动。

瞳孔剧烈收缩，他瞪着眼睛，猛地抬眸，看向主栋别墅的第三层楼。

窗帘是关上的。

那间房间的灯光比其他房间的光似乎都更要亮眼刺目一些，所以如果盯着窗帘看，甚至可以隐隐约约看到房间内不算清楚的人影。

不止一个人。

电话那头，是断断续续，颤抖又慌乱的哭腔。

三楼有光处，方喻之似乎看到了隔着窗帘按在玻璃上的两只手。

喉结动了几下。

半晌，他才眨了眨眼。

不、不可能的……

方喻之低下头去，无措又抵触地将脑海中那无端不明的想法抛掷脑后！

——那是、那是宋瓷的小……

不知想到什么，方喻之眉头皱得更紧，眼底闪过一抹不加掩饰的慌乱。

已经不是了。

他们已经……没有任何关系了。

那也不可能的……

他们相差七岁，祝砚铮不会轻易对女人动心，更重要的是……

宋瓷自始至终喜欢的，是他，是他方喻之才对！

对！是这样的！一定是这样的！

一定是祝砚铮强迫宋瓷做了什么，现在孟晚才是祝砚铮的侄女，为了哄孟晚开心，祝砚铮一定会拿宋瓷开刀！

想到这里，方喻之的心里终于多了几分底气。

深吸一口气，他终于找到了自己的音调：“祝砚铮……先生，我知道你在听，我知道你能听见！”

“这件事宋瓷是无辜的，她真的是把你当作亲叔叔一样敬重，您身居高位，放过她可以吗？”

“呜……”

电话那头，少女的哭声时断时续，像是哭求，又像是制止。

“祝先生，如果您担心孟晚会因此生气，我可以告诉孟晚，我可以让孟晚放过宋瓷。”

“不、小——”

“孟晚她会听我的！祝先生，您放过宋瓷，宋瓷她真的什么都不知道！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fang Yuzhi frowned slightly. At first, he thought it was Zhu Yanzheng who wanted to punish Song Ci to make Meng Wan happy because Song Ci was not a Song family member.

Thinking of this, Fang Yuzhi's face became darker and he growled at the other end of the phone: "Zhu Yanzheng, let her go!"

"Don't hurt her, she's innocent!"

"I will take her away! I will not let her appear in front of you again!"

But I don't know if it was his imagination, but it seemed that every time he said something, the girl on the other end of the phone cried louder.

In the end, the small and soft crying turned into intermittent sobs as if it could not be suppressed.

Fang Yuzhi's eyes widened, as if he finally realized something was wrong.

This is...

Holding the phone tightly with his fingers, Fang Yuzhi's Adam's apple rolled as he listened to the voice coming from the phone.

His pupils shrank violently, he stared, and suddenly raised his eyes to look at the third floor of the main villa.

The curtains are closed.

The light in that room seems to be brighter and more dazzling than the light in other rooms, so if you stare at the curtains, you can even vaguely see the unclear figures in the room.

More than one person.

On the other end of the phone was intermittent, trembling and panicked crying.

In the light on the third floor, Fang Yuzhi seemed to see two hands pressing against the glass through the curtains.

The Adam's apple moved a few times.

After a long while, he blinked.

No, it's impossible...

Fang Yuzhi lowered his head, helpless and reluctant to throw away the unexplained thoughts in his mind!

——That's, that's Song Ci's little...

Unexpectedly, Fang Yuzhi frowned even more tightly, and an undisguised panic flashed in his eyes.

Not anymore.

They no longer have any relationship.

That's impossible...

They are seven years apart. Zhu Yanzheng will not be tempted by women easily. More importantly...

Song Ci liked him from beginning to end, and it was him who Fang Yuzhi was right!

right!That's it!That must be the case!

Zhu Yanzheng must have forced Song Ci to do something. Now Meng Wan is Zhu Yanzheng's niece. In order to make Meng Wan happy, Zhu Yanzheng will definitely operate on Song Ci!

Thinking of this, Fang Yuzhi finally felt a little more confident.

Taking a deep breath, he finally found his tone: "Zhu Yanzheng...Sir, I know you are listening, I know you can hear it!"

"Song Ci is innocent in this matter. She really respects you as her own uncle. You are in a high position, can you let her go?"

"Woo..."

On the other end of the phone, the girl cried intermittently, like begging, but also like stopping.

"Mr. Zhu, if you are worried that Meng Wan will be angry because of this, I can tell Meng Wan that I can let Meng Wan let Song Ci go."

"No, little——"

"Meng Wan will listen to me! Mr. Zhu, please let Song Ci go. Song Ci really doesn't know anything!"
